product_one_liner.value: nudge is an employer-sponsored global financial education and wellbeing platform that gives employees personalized financial guidance, education, and benefits support.
product_one_liner.notes: The FAQ describes nudge as a global financial education platform and says it is provided to employees through a sponsoring organization; the one-liner summarizes that product and audience.

pricing_page.notes: The FAQ says pricing depends on customer-specific factors and directs prospective buyers to contact nudge for commercial options; the contact page is a callback/contact form, not a public list of plans or prices. This supports no public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Meta case study names Meta as the client, and the Siemens case study states Siemens chose nudge; these are two named customers. | named_customers.0: The cited customer case study is explicitly about Meta. | named_customers.1: The cited case study states Siemens chose nudge.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 116 employees; that count falls in the 101–200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company contact page labels the address as its Global HQ in London. | hq_country: The company contact page labels the listed address its Global HQ and gives the location as London, United Kingdom.

founded_year.notes: The company About page says the founders’ idea became nudge in 2013, establishing the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The official blog index organizes posts under benefits, best practice, client stories, employee benefits, financial wellbeing trends, and company news; the shown post topics are industry/editorial and customer stories, not engineering or product-build posts. It does not evidence the two technical posts required for a true value.

public_docs.notes: The company navigation exposes platform, client stories, resources, careers, FAQ, and legal/security links, but no documentation or developer portal; the available product FAQ is a single FAQ page rather than a multi-article docs/help site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers page lists two open roles: Strategic Account Executive and Senior Software Engineer. Neither title is an AI, ML, or data-science role under the specified title criteria.

model_provider.notes: The AI page names the product’s AI as numa but does not identify an underlying model or model provider. The trust center’s visible subprocessor entry names Microsoft and Mailgun, not an AI model provider, so the public provider remains unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The trust-center overview explicitly says nudge is certified to ISO/IEC 27001, and its compliance list names GDPR. Both are among the requested certification categories; it does not name SOC 2, HIPAA, or PCI DSS in this cited range. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly states nudge is certified to ISO/IEC 27001. | compliance_certs.1: GDPR appears in the Trust Center compliance list and is one of the categories explicitly requested.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding-history profile identifies Growth Equity as the latest round and dates it March 18, 2021. | funding_date: The company’s investment announcement is dated March 16, 2021, and a funding-history profile dates the latest Growth Equity round March 18, 2021; both establish the requested YYYY-MM as 2021-03. | funding_amount_usd: The company-matched Crunchbase data lists a single Kennet Partners round at USD 7 million; Dealroom independently lists the March 2021 Kennet financing as £5.0 million, consistent with the approximate USD amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The recorded Kennet funding is dated March 2021, and the funding database reports one round; this is before the 18 months preceding November 2026, so no in-window funding is evidenced.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers posting is for a Strategic Account Executive and includes an application link, meeting the specified account-executive hiring criterion.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced on September 1, 2026 that it introduced personalized financial action plans, a substantial new product experience within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The dated company announcement says nudge appointed Debi Kesselring and Greg Goebert as U.S. Vice Presidents on October 15, 2026, within the preceding 12 months.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The technology profile identifies Salesforce.com and Pardot as systems used for the company’s website/email operations, supporting these visible sales/marketing stack signals. | crm_stack_signal.0: The technology profile explicitly names Salesforce.com. | crm_stack_signal.1: The technology profile explicitly names Pardot as the domain email system.
